name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task restricts dropping the key while the door is closed ('do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once'), but the only clause is Existence(target_picked_up). Since key_lost is defined as a drop of the key with the door not open, the ban is already contained in the event, so it should be a hard Absence(key_lost) alongside the goal. Add it.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) captures the goal, and key_lost is already defined as dropping the key with the door not open, so the task's conditional ban is correctly the plain hard Absence(key_lost).
